extracted.name: How to Press Tofu
extracted.description: The best way to press tofu is with a tofu press (we like the Tofuture tofu press), and if you plan on cooking tofu often, I recommend investing in one—check out my guide to the best tofu presses. But if you don't have one, don't worry about it. Follow these steps to press tofu without a tofu press!
instruction_lines: Wrap the block of tofu in a clean kitchen towel and place it on a flat surface. To capture the excess liquid that the tofu releases, place it on a rimmed baking sheet.
Place a cast-iron skillet* on top of the wrapped tofu block.
Press for 30 minutes before using in your favorite tofu recipes.
